change: Fixed Supervisor Inspect form not clearing when switching trucks mid-entry. Root cause: the field-clear list had a typo ('supTrailer' instead of 'supTrailerNo'), so Trailer No never actually reset. Also Origin/Gate In/Fuel/Dept Logged, Photos, deferred-issue notes, and job department blocks were never cleared on truck-switch at all (only on Save) -- so picking a different truck from the dropdown before saving could leave the previous truck's Trailer No, driver info, origin, fuel, photos, and job entries showing on screen. All of these now reset properly the instant a different truck is selected.
